sentences.en: Hello, I'm Hayden.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是海登。

sentences.en: I'm one of the archaeologists investigating the site here at Bidcuster.
sentences.zh: 我是正在比德卡斯特遗址开展考古调查的考古学家之一。

sentences.en: This is the third summer for this community project, and most of the people digging here are volunteers.
sentences.zh: 这是这个社区项目的第三个夏季，现场大部分挖掘人员都是志愿者。

sentences.en: I'm a full -time archaeologist for the town council, but I was asked to join the project by NHA, a charity which sets up projects like this up and down the country.
sentences.zh: 我是镇议会的全职考古学家，但应全国性慈善机构NHA的邀请加入了该项目，该机构在全国各地设立此类项目。

sentences.en: As you can see, we're next to Bidcaster Castle, which is great because the owners let us use their facilities.
sentences.zh: 如您所见，我们紧邻比德卡斯特城堡，这非常有利，因为城堡主人允许我们使用他们的设施。

sentences.en: So, how did we get to where we are today?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是如何走到今天这一步的呢？

sentences.en: MAN: y archaeology projects happen when an ancient object is found, and in our case that object was a gold coin.
sentences.zh: MAN：大多数考古项目始于发现古代器物，而我们的项目正是由一枚金币的发现引发的。

sentences.en: Coins are often found by people using metal detectors to look for things buried in the ground or coins are uncovered when wild animals like rabbits have been digging tunnels.
sentences.zh: 硬币常由使用金属探测器搜寻地下埋藏物品的人发现，或由兔子等野生动物挖洞时偶然暴露出来。

sentences.en: Here, a walker found it on the ground after a rainstorm washed away some of the earth and sand.
sentences.zh: 在这里，一名徒步者在一场暴雨冲走部分泥土和沙子后，在地面上发现了这枚金币。

sentences.en: When the story of the gold coin hit the news, Peter Swift, an amateur historian, contacted me to say he believed there had been a village on this site, centuries before the castle was built.
sentences.zh: 当这枚金币的消息登上新闻后，业余历史学家彼得·斯威夫特联系了我，表示他相信在城堡建成数世纪之前，此地曾存在一座村庄。

sentences.en: Just by chance, the team found some old maps and documents in our library, which showed 500 -year-old drawings of ruined buildings on the grassy area between the outer stone walls of the castle and the river.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，团队在我们的图书馆中找到了一些古老地图和文献，其中显示城堡外围石墙与河流之间的草地曾有500年前的废墟建筑绘图。

sentences.en: We knew then we were onto something.
sentences.zh: 那时我们就意识到，我们可能有了重大发现。

sentences.en: Over the three summers the team has been here, we've found the remains of several buildings, and more broken pots than you can count.
sentences.zh: 过去三个夏季，团队在此发掘出多座建筑遗迹，以及数不胜数的破碎陶器。

sentences.en: Normally you'd expect to find brooches and other jewellery, but we're still waiting to uncover any such items.
sentences.zh: 通常人们会期待发现胸针及其他珠宝首饰，但我们至今尚未发掘出任何此类物品。

sentences.en: The people who once lived here were skilled at making tools from animal bones, as you'll see when you visit the exhibition.
sentences.zh: 曾居住于此的人们擅长用动物骨骼制作工具，您参观展览时将亲眼见到这些工具。

sentences.en: Besides the discovery of the village, we've also found evidence of human activity on the other side of the river.
sentences.zh: 除发现这座村庄外，我们在河对岸还发现了人类活动的证据。

sentences.en: No other houses or huts so far, but we can see the borders of an ancient field system.
sentences.zh: 目前尚未发现其他房屋或小屋，但我们已能辨识出一处古代农田系统的边界。

sentences.en: At one point we found a long wall and thought it was an ancient palace, but it turned out to be a modern wall.
sentences.zh: 曾有一次，我们发现了一堵长墙，一度以为是古代宫殿，结果证实是一堵现代墙体。

sentences.en: This summer's work will end soon, but we'll be back next summer.
sentences.zh: 今年夏季的工作即将结束，但我们明年夏天还会回来。

sentences.en: In the meantime, we're putting on a series of guided tours for school groups this autumn.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，今年秋季我们将为学校团体举办一系列导览参观活动。

sentences.en: Oh, and maybe you saw the TV documentary about our project.
sentences.zh: 哦，也许你们看过关于我们项目的电视纪录片。

sentences.en: That suggests the objects we've found are going to the town's museum, but we don't know that for sure yet.
sentences.zh: 这表明我们发现的文物将送往镇上的博物馆，但目前我们还不能确定。

sentences.en: When you enter the site, please make sure you keep to the paths at all times.
sentences.zh: 进入遗址时，请务必始终沿指定路径行走。

sentences.en: There are a few other things, the highlights of the site if you like, that I want to mention.
sentences.zh: 还有几处其他地点，可以说是遗址的亮点，我想提一下。

sentences.en: Take a look at the map.
sentences.zh: 请看一下地图。

sentences.en: Our present location is marked at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 我们当前的位置标在地图底部。

sentences.en: This year, we've identified the foundations of an ancient bridge, and it's really exciting today because a team of divers are in the river searching for lost objects.
sentences.zh: 今年，我们已确认了一座古桥的地基，今天尤其令人兴奋，因为一支潜水队正在河中搜寻失落的文物。

sentences.en: To reach the bridge, take the main path ahead of you, go straight on, and keep going till the path bends to the left.
sentences.zh: 要到达这座桥，请沿您前方的主路前行，一直向前走，直到道路向左转弯。

sentences.en: You'll see a smaller track leading off to the right.
sentences.zh: 您会看到一条较小的小径向右分岔。

sentences.en: Follow that to take you to the river, where the divers are.
sentences.zh: 沿这条小径前行，即可抵达潜水员所在的河边。

sentences.en: You might be interested to see the rubbish pit.
sentences.zh: 您可能对垃圾坑感兴趣。

sentences.en: This is very near the castle walls in the north -west corner of the site.
sentences.zh: 它位于遗址西北角、靠近城堡城墙的位置。

sentences.en: It actually dates to the time of the castle and not the ancient village.
sentences.zh: 它的年代实际上可追溯至城堡时期，而非古代村落时期。

sentences.en: We found oyster shells and fish bones, and we assumed they were thrown from the castle kitchen above.
sentences.zh: 我们发现了牡蛎壳和鱼骨，推测它们是从上方城堡厨房丢弃下来的。

sentences.en: One area we excavated in the first summer uncovered the site of a meeting hall.
sentences.zh: 第一个夏季发掘的一个区域，发现了会议厅的遗址。

sentences.en: We knew it was an important building because it had two rows of post holes, deep enough to support a large roof.
sentences.zh: 我们认定这是一座重要建筑，因为它有两排柱洞，深度足以支撑一个大型屋顶。

sentences.en: It is the largest structure in the central area of the site next to the current excavation area.
sentences.zh: 它是遗址中心区域最大的建筑，紧邻当前的发掘区。

sentences.en: Last year we discovered a fish pond in the ancient village.
sentences.zh: 去年我们在古代村落中发现了一个鱼塘。

sentences.en: Normally these were beside a river.
sentences.zh: 通常这类鱼塘都建在河边。

sentences.en: The pond here is further away, but it's possible the river has moved slightly.
sentences.zh: 此处的鱼塘离河较远，但有可能是河流略微改道所致。

sentences.en: Anyway, to get there from here, you turn right at the first information board you come to and follow the path into the trees.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，从这里出发，你走到第一个信息牌时向右转，然后沿着小路进入树林。

sentences.en: Before you come out of the trees, you'll see it on your right.
sentences.zh: 在你走出树林之前，它会在你的右侧。

sentences.en: If you reach the river, you've gone too far.
sentences.zh: 如果你到达了河边，那就走得太远了。

sentences.en: So, does anyone have...
sentences.zh: 那么，有人有……
